verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so data portability is a fair question, but the evidence pack has no documented bulk or full-account export, no open-format download, and no offboarding or data-portability guidance. The only nearby items are mentions of 'audit-ready reports' and a page title for 'Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs'. Neither shows that all customer data can be exported, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Community reports describe an account being disabled and a refused termination, which only underlines the absence of any documented exit path.
